plan: A mage who sets fire to everything he touches and melts grouped-up teams.
aSurveiller: His Q (Sear). If you are on fire, this fireball stuns you: when you are burning, stay behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his Q stops on the first enemy hit.
Spread out in fights: his R bounces between nearby enemies.
Engage him up close: he is fragile and has no escape.
forces: Stuns if the target is on fire.
His R is brutal against grouped teams.

sorts.P: His spells set the target ablaze.
sorts.Q: Fireball that stuns a burning target.
sorts.W: Pillar of flame on the ground after a short delay.
sorts.E: Explosion that spreads to nearby enemies.
sorts.R: Fireball that bounces up to 5 times between enemies.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, and very strong in team fights.
